title: The wedge at rocket-b (506 -> 504) found: a waist in the corridor narrower than the hull's centre could thread; squeezed, the centre keeps the probes' clearance; the corridor probe says why a step was refused
context: Open since 2026-10-06 (2026-10-06-corridor-probe-and-the-hull-in-narrow-tiles): the MÖRK driven by --corridor-probe to rocket-b wedged at the last corridor cell before the lander's clearing (506 -> 504, 2.7 cells from the lander) with nothing the diagnostics could name ahead; the pickup radius was widened so the part is secured from there, and the planned next step was a freeBlocked-reason hook. Tonight's main (dedce7e3): the route is unchanged (84 cells, 32 corridor, 506/504 at 76/77); the first baseline run stopped at cell 49 of 84 with 45.6 s off the route at 25392, a later one reproduced the 10-06 result (PART SECURED at 77 of 84, cell 506, 38.2 s).
outcome: THE HOOK: freeBlocked (src/td-tab.js) names the test that refused a candidate (off, rock, container, pedestal, breach, `depth before>after` in cells with `sq` when squeezed, `solid <structure>`, gate, unit); src/fx/hull-drive.js logs each refused branch of the manual frame (step, slide, glance, creep, unstick) and showcase.drive().block hands the last frame's log to the probe's trace. THROUGH=1 drives on past PART SECURED to the route's end; GEOM=<cell> (or the slowest cell) dumps the neighbourhood's centres and rock tags (showcase.cellsNear) into the trace. With THROUGH the wedge reproduced: 42.1 s in 506, no kick, and every refusal was the footprint's depth, squeezed too (`step:depth -0.003>0.019 sq slide:depth -0.003>0.015 sq unstick:0.05`). THE CAUSE, read off the dumped board: 506 and 504 are 1.268 cells apart and the rock 505 sits in the bend's inside 0.95 and 0.97 cells from each, 41712/41711 across; 0.54 cells of the 506|504 boundary lie between the faces. The centre point keeps min(unitScale, cellSide) x 0.3 = 0.3 x tankUnit 0.684 = 0.205 cells of room, which leaves a band of 0.06 cells to cross in, a fifth of a cell off the line between the two centres; every drive takes that line (the step aims at the next cell, the slide works off 505's centre, the creep and the unstick pull back to 506's centre). The squeeze dropped the nose and tail but never the centre's clearance, so the hull cycled: refused, the unstick's pull back, one step through, the stuck clock decaying, refused again; stuck.t never reached after + ramp (0.6 s) where the depth test lets go. THE FIX: squeezed, the centre keeps HULL_STUCK.thread 0.04 cells (src/domain/hull-contact.js threadClearance), the nose and tail probes' own clearance; unsqueezed nothing changes. test/hull-contact.mjs carries the waist read off the planet (fails without the rule). The probe's driver also backs out of 1.5 s of crawling OFF the route (a target across a rock corner was the driver's fault; a wedge on the route is never backed out of).
alternatives: Widening the pickup radius again: refused by the brief; the wedge was the hull's

A slide along the deepest face's normal and a creep toward the waist instead of the cell's centre: would find the 0.06-cell band, but a band that narrow is a needle's eye at 0.02 to 0.05 cells a frame; not tried
Capping the centre's clearance by each passage's measured waist: right in principle, needs a per-edge geometry pass over 71,314 cells; not for this round
Carving the waist open (the board or the bake): changes the pinned planet; not tried
evidence: artifacts/wedge-notes.md (the running log), artifacts/corridor-trace-instr3.json (before, THROUGH: slow cell 506, i 76, open 2, 42.1 s, 0 kicks; every refusal `depth`), artifacts/corridor-trace-geom2.json (the board round 506)

--corridor-probe THROUGH=1 after the fix, rocket-b: PART SECURED at route cell 77 of 84 (cell 506) 50.5 s; REACHED at cell 84 of 84 in 54.2 s; kicks 8; still 0 of 507 samples; slow cells [] (506 left in 0.8 s); again: REACHED at cell 84 of 84 in 52.0 s; kicks 7; still 0 of 493; slow cells []
regressions, THROUGH=1: rocket-a REACHED at cell 90 of 90 in 51.5 s, slow cells []; wreck REACHED at cell 46 of 46 in 31.0 s, slow cells []; rocket-c REACHED at cell 84 of 84 in 44.1 s, slow cells []
npm test (269 programs), npm run check, npm run build pass; --grow passes (grow-solar-rising, grow-bays, grow-hugin, grow-finished, grow-gate-repair)
